# Joe Durkin speaks about Gulf construction disputes in Arabian Gulf Business Insight


August 14, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Arabian Gulf Business Insight* features an interview with[Joe Durkin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joe-durkin/) in an article on the use of legal finance for Gulf disputes.


He says: "Construction disputes continue to dominate the regional landscape, especially in light of ongoing megaprojects and infrastructure initiatives. These are often high-value, document-heavy matters, well suited to funding."


[Read the full article here](https://www.agbi.com/analysis/law/2025/08/litigation-funders-target-gulf-disputes-as-claims-surge/) .
